content: प्रवण {%a.%} Sloping down, inclined, shelving, flowing downwards; प्रागुदक्प्रबणां वेदिं विशालां दीप्तपावकाम् (ददर्श) <ls>Rām. 2. 99. 24</ls>. .²2 Steep, abrupt, precipitous. .²3 Crooked, bent. .²4 Inclined, disposed to, tending to (<ab>oft.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); भयेकप्रवणः <ls>Ki. 3. 19</ls>; श्वपचप्रवणो भवेत् <ls>Mb. 13. 136. 18</ls>. .²5 Devoted or attached to, addicted to, intent on, prone to, full of; नृभिः प्राणत्राणप्रवणमतिभिः कैश्चिदधुना <ls>Bh. 3. 29</ls>; <ls>Śi. 8. 35</ls>; <ls>Mu. 5. 21</ls>; <ls>Ki. 2. 44</ls>. .²6 Favourably inclined or disposed towards; <ls>Ku. 4. 42</ls>. .²7 Eager, ready; प्रवणोऽस्मि वरं दातुम् <ls>Mb. 15. 29. 22</ls>. फलसंपत्प्रवणः <ls>Ki. 2. 8</ls>. .²8 Endowed with, possessed of. .²9 Humbled, modestly humble, submissive. .²10 Decayed, wasted, waning. .²11 Generous. .{@-णः@} .²1 A place where four roads meet. .²2 A moment. .²3 A whirlpool. .{@-णम्@} .²1 A descent, a steep descent, precipice; उदके भूरियं धार्या मर्तव्यं प्रवणे मया <ls>Mb. 5. 136. 13</ls>. .²2 The side of a hill, slope, declivity. .²3 The belly. .²4 An access to.
